雅思周末复习 · 第 5 周（11 月 21 日 周六）

这周五天（11 月 16 日到 20 日）的内容都在这一页里，大概 60 分钟。建议顺序：单词 15 分钟，听写 10 分钟，听力表达 5 分钟，阅读 15 分钟，写作口语 15 分钟。不用联网，手机上也能用。

3. 听力表达回顾（5 分钟）

周一周二是两集 BBC 6 Minute English，周三到周五是官方样题。每天 5 个表达，共 25 个。中文默认隐藏，先自己想意思再点开。斜体是录音里的原句，前面是说话人。

完整音频和原文都在每天的早间页面里（11-16 到 11-20 早间），这里为了文件小没有再放进来。哪天表达忘得多，就回那天页面再听一遍。

周一 11月16日：BBC 6 Minute English：Cycling around the world（骑行：荷兰和阿联酋）

  • deeply ingrained 根深蒂固的点击显示
    Neil: Deeply ingrained are two words that go together commonly, and it means something that's firmly established within a person or culture, and unlikely to change.
  • take off （突然）火起来，兴旺起来点击显示
    Becca: Take off is a phrasal verb meaning to suddenly become popular or successful.
  • quality of life 生活质量点击显示
    Becca: The phrase quality of life refers to someone's level of enjoyment, comfort and health when living in a particular place.
  • liveability 宜居程度点击显示
    Becca: The noun liveability means the degree to which a place is pleasant to live in.
  • a copy and paste 照搬照抄点击显示
    Neil: Martin uses the phrase a copy and paste to mean an exact copy of something, which is moved and put somewhere else.

周二 11月17日：BBC 6 Minute English：Could vaccines cure cancer?（癌症疫苗）

  • a long time coming 盼了很久才来，姗姗来迟点击显示
    Phil: Tom says that the development of the cancer vaccine has been a long time coming, and this means that it's taken a lot of time to achieve.
  • false dawn 假象，空欢喜一场点击显示
    Georgie: Tom also says there have been some false dawns, an expression meaning that something looks like it's improving when it's actually not.
  • in this space 在这个领域点击显示
    Phil: Space here means field of research
  • breakthrough 突破点击显示
    Georgie: Scientists think they might have made a breakthrough. That means they've made significant progress.
  • prime 为……做好准备，预先激活点击显示
    Georgie: If you prime something, you get it ready.

周三 11月18日：官方样题：货运公司询价表格（Q1-8）+ 国家艺术中心笔记表格（Q11-20）

  • picked up from 从……取件点击显示
    Agent: And where would you like the box picked up from?
  • calculate the volume 算体积点击显示
    Agent: So I'll calculate the volume in a moment and get some quotes for that.
  • cater for 能满足……的需求，面向……点击显示
    Dave: The Centre itself is a huge complex that caters for a great range of arts.
  • in public hands 归公共部门所有点击显示
    Dave: It's not privately owned, like many arts centres, but is still in public hands
  • a reduction on 比……便宜了一些，降价点击显示
    Dave: which is a reduction on the usual price of £5.50

周四 11月19日：官方样题：保险选择、留学生活讲座、远程学习访谈、选修课对话

  • comprehensive cover 全面保障点击显示
    Agent: there's the highest comprehensive cover which is Premium rate
  • be stung 吃过亏，被坑过点击显示
    Customer: I've been stung before with Economy insurance so I'll go for the highest.
  • get involved in 参与，加入点击显示
    John Parker: you can get involved in activities in your local community, join a group of some kind
  • maintain a high level of motivation 保持很强的学习动力点击显示
    Rachel: I needed to maintain a high level of motivation
  • be made up of modules 由一个个模块组成点击显示
    Rachel: the degree is made up of modules, so you can take time off between them if you need to

周五 11月20日：官方样题：酒店匹配（Q1-4）+ 镇图书馆平面图（Q11-15）

  • out in the country 在乡下，在郊外点击显示
    Official: that's out in the country, about ten kilometres away, very peaceful
  • took their first guests 开始接待第一批客人点击显示
    Official: they took their first guests just a few months ago but it's already got an excellent reputation
  • on your right as you go in 进门右手边点击显示
    Ann: my desk is just on your right as you go in
  • carry straight on 一直往前走点击显示

4. 阅读易错题回顾（15 分钟）

从这周五篇 G 类阅读里挑出最容易错的题，每篇 5 道，共 25 道。主要是同义替换、标题干扰项、NOT GIVEN 和填空的单复数、字数。先自己判断，再点开答案，对照原文那一句。

判断题口诀：原文说反了是 FALSE，原文没说是 NOT GIVEN。填空题记得核对单复数和字数要求，匹配题字母可以重复用。这周的阅读是我自己编写的题，答案和解析也是自编。

周一 Section 1：一日游大巴广告（A到E 匹配）+ 诊所新病人须知（表格填空）

第 2 题　哪则广告（A到E）：is suitable for people who use a wheelchair

点开看答案和解析

答案：C

Our coach for this trip is fitted with a wheelchair lift, and the whole shopping village is step-free.

有轮椅升降机、全程无台阶，选 C。A 明确 not suitable for wheelchair users，是干扰项。

原文出处：Paragraph C

第 3 题　哪则广告（A到E）：offers a lower fare for children

点开看答案和解析

答案：B

Adults £18; children under 12 travel at half price.

lower fare for children = half price，选 B。C 的 voucher 是购物打折，不是车费便宜。

原文出处：Paragraph B

第 6 题　哪则广告（A到E）：includes the cost of entry to the main attraction

点开看答案和解析

答案：A

The price of £35 includes your admission ticket to both the castle and the gardens.

cost of entry = admission ticket，选 A。D 的剧院票 must be bought separately，不包含。

原文出处：Paragraph A

第 8 题　表格填空（ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER）：bring proof of address, e.g. a recent (8) ______ bill

点开看答案和解析

答案：utility

…bring proof of address, such as a recent utility bill.

表格里已有 bill，只填 utility，填 utility bill 就重复了。

原文出处：Paragraph F

第 10 题　表格填空（ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER）：patients over 40: free health check with a (10) ______

点开看答案和解析

答案：nurse

…invited to a free health check with one of our nurses.

空前有 a，要用单数 nurse，写 nurses 算错。

原文出处：Paragraph F

周二 Section 2：保险公司新员工须知（标题匹配）+ 办公楼消防规定（句子填空）

第 3 题　Paragraph C 选哪个标题？
i Getting to know the organisation and your team　ii Ways of reaching the workplace　iii Planning your annual holidays　iv Time and places to have a meal　v What is and is not suitable to wear　vi Looking after your possessions　vii Joining social activities with colleagues　viii Informing the company when you are ill　ix Changing your working hours

点开看答案和解析

答案：iv　Time and places to have a meal

…a 45-minute lunch break… The staff restaurant… a small kitchen on every floor…

讲午休时段和在哪吃饭，time and places to have a meal，选 iv。别被 between 12 noon and 2.30 pm 误导去选 ix，那是午休时间，不是改工作时间。

原文出处：Paragraph C

第 6 题　Paragraph F 选哪个标题？
i Getting to know the organisation and your team　ii Ways of reaching the workplace　iii Planning your annual holidays　iv Time and places to have a meal　v What is and is not suitable to wear　vi Looking after your possessions　vii Joining social activities with colleagues　viii Informing the company when you are ill　ix Changing your working hours

点开看答案和解析

答案：viii　Informing the company when you are ill

If you are too unwell to come to work, you must telephone your line manager…

ill = unwell，informing the company = telephone your line manager，选 viii。iii 和 vii 原文没讲，是干扰项。

原文出处：Paragraph F

第 10 题　句子填空（ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER）：Fire wardens can be identified by the colour of their ______

点开看答案和解析

答案：jacket

…a fire warden, who will be wearing a bright yellow jacket.

题目说 colour of their ___，颜色已经在题干里了，填的是名词 jacket，不是 yellow。这是今天最容易错的一题。

原文出处：Paragraph H

第 11 题　句子填空（ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER）：Before leaving, wardens make sure nobody is in the toilets or ______ rooms.

点开看答案和解析

答案：meeting

…checking that toilets and meeting rooms are empty…

make sure nobody is in = checking… are empty，空后已经有 rooms，只填 meeting。

原文出处：Paragraph H

第 13 题　句子填空（ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER）：Within two weeks of starting, new staff have to finish an online ______

点开看答案和解析

答案：module

All new employees must complete an online fire safety module within their first two weeks.

finish = complete，填 module。只能填一个词，fire safety module 超字数。

原文出处：Paragraph I

周三 Section 3：Waiting in Line 排队的科学（单选 + TFNG + 摘要选词）

第 2 题　According to paragraph C, what happens when cashiers are almost always busy?
A. Waiting times increase at a steady rate.　B. A small rise in customers can cause a large rise in waiting times.　C. The staff start to work more quickly.　D. Customers decide to shop somewhere else.

点开看答案和解析

答案：B　fairness

But as the number of customers approaches the maximum that the staff can serve, waiting times begin to grow very sharply.

顾客人数差一点，队伍长好几倍，对应 small rise … large rise，选 B。A 正好和 do not rise steadily 相反。

原文出处：Paragraph C

第 5 题　TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN：Erlang discovered that the arrival time of each individual call could be predicted exactly.

点开看答案和解析

答案：FALSE

…although individual calls arrived at random, the overall pattern of calls could be predicted with surprising accuracy.

单个电话是随机的，能预测的是整体规律，题目说单个能精确预测，和原文相反，选 FALSE。

原文出处：Paragraph B

第 7 题　TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN：Maister's article was based on interviews with bank customers.

点开看答案和解析

答案：NOT GIVEN

In an influential article published in 1985, the American business writer David Maister set out a number of principles about the psychology of waiting.

原文只说他写了文章、提了原则，没说依据是什么，更没提采访银行顾客，选 NOT GIVEN。

原文出处：Paragraph E

第 8 题　TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN：The Houston airport employed more baggage handlers after passengers complained.

点开看答案和解析

答案：FALSE

Rather than hiring more baggage handlers, the airport moved the arrival gates further from the baggage hall…

rather than hiring 说明没有多雇人，选 FALSE。

原文出处：Paragraph E

第 14 题　摘要填空，从 A到I 选词：Finally, paying extra to skip the line raises questions of ______ , because people want a queue to treat everyone equally.
A. predictable　B. fairness　C. shorter　D. expensive　E. transaction　F. comfortable　G. unfair　H. longer　I. staff

点开看答案和解析

答案：B　fairness

There is also a question of fairness.

questions of 后面要名词，选 B fairness。注意 unfair 是形容词，放不进这里。

原文出处：Paragraph G

…open 24 hours a day, so you can collect your car whenever your flight lands.

The card itself costs $10, which is not refundable.

not refundable 就是不退钱，和题目相反，选 FALSE。

…can be used on all buses, trains and ferries in the Westbury area.

原文只说 Westbury 地区的公交，没提机场巴士，不能推断，选 NOT GIVEN。别自己脑补。

第 13 题　TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN：The daily limit on fares is the same on every day of the week.

点开看答案和解析

…once you have paid $12 in fares on a weekday… At weekends, the cap is reduced to $6.

第 4 题　哪一段（A到I）：a situation in which new staff may receive extra support before working alone（字母可重复用）

If either of you feels you need more time, the shadowing period can be extended by up to five days.

5. 写作和口语回顾（15 分钟）

下面的范文都是我自己写的参考范文，不是官方答案。先别看，花 3 分钟口头说一下你会怎么写或者怎么讲，再点开对照。题目原话以你当天的任务为准，我这里按话题整理。

周二大作文：大公司还是小公司（Task 2 讨论类）

Some people prefer to work for a large company, while others prefer to work for a small company. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

点开看参考范文（约 279 词，目标 7 分左右）

Choosing between a large company and a small one is a personal decision, and both options have real advantages. In my opinion, a large company suits people who are just starting out, although a small one can be more rewarding later on.

Those who prefer large companies usually point to security and structure. A big employer normally offers a stable salary, clear promotion paths and formal training programmes, so a new graduate always knows what to learn next. Large firms also tend to provide better benefits, such as health insurance and paid leave, which matter a great deal to people with families. In addition, a well-known name on a CV can make it much easier to find a job somewhere else in the future.

On the other hand, many people enjoy working for a small company because their role is wider and more flexible. In a team of ten, an employee may be involved in sales, planning and customer service in the same week, and this variety speeds up learning. Staff are also closer to the owner, so their ideas are more likely to be heard and put into practice. Moreover, a small workplace often feels like a family, which can make daily life more pleasant.

Personally, I believe a large company is the better choice for the first few years of a career, because the training and the stability give a solid base. Once someone has gained experience and confidence, moving to a small company, where they can take more responsibility, may be more satisfying.

In conclusion, neither type of employer is better for everyone. The right choice depends on a person's stage of life, goals and personality.

结构：开头改写题目并亮出立场，第二段讲大公司的好处，第三段讲小公司的好处，第四段说我的看法，最后一句收尾。讨论类题目一定要两边都写，还要有自己的观点。

可以背的句子：point to security and structure（强调稳定和规范）；this variety speeds up learning（这种多样性让人学得更快）；give a solid base（打下扎实基础）；depends on a person's stage of life（取决于人生阶段）。

周四书信：感谢帮我照看房子和猫的朋友（半正式到非正式）

You recently stayed away from home for two weeks and a friend looked after your flat and your cat while you were away. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter, thank your friend, say what you did while you were away, and invite your friend to do something to say thank you. Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter: Dear ...,

点开看参考范文（约 155 词，朋友之间的口语化语气）

Dear Sam,

Thank you so much for looking after my flat and Milo while I was away. I honestly don't know what I would have done without you. When I came home, everything was spotless, the plants were still alive, and Milo looked very happy. He even seemed a little fatter!

I had a fantastic time. I spent the first week by the sea with my cousins, swimming every morning and eating far too much seafood. Then I took the train to the mountains and went hiking for three days. The views were incredible, and I took loads of photos to show you.

To say thank you, I would love to take you out for dinner. How about next Saturday evening? There is a new Italian restaurant near the station that I have been wanting to try. My treat, of course! Let me know if that day works for you, and if not, just pick another one.

Thanks again for being such a great friend. I really owe you one.

Best wishes,

Alex

三个要点都覆盖了：先感谢并说具体好处，再讲旅行见闻，最后提出请吃饭。好用的口语表达：I don't know what I would have done without you（没有你我真不知道怎么办）；My treat（我请客）；I really owe you one（我欠你一个人情）。关系很熟用 Best wishes 或 Love，开头用名字 Dear Sam。

周四大作文计划：公共交通应该免费吗（只做提纲）

Public transport should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

点开看 10 分钟提纲（参考）

立场：部分同意：在通勤高峰和低收入人群中免费有好处，但全部免费不现实，更好的办法是大幅降价加针对性补贴。

第 1 段 开头：改写题目 + 直接说立场：I partly agree. Free travel would help some groups, but I do not think it is the best way to run a transport system.

第 2 段 同意的理由：1. 减少私家车，缓解堵车和污染。2. 帮助低收入家庭、学生、老人，让大家都出得起门。例子：有的城市试行免费后，乘客明显增加。

第 3 段 不同意的理由：1. 钱从哪来：运营、维修、司机工资都要花钱，最后还是靠税收，不如让使用的人付一部分。2. 免费后可能挤爆，短途的人也不走路了，反而服务变差。

第 4 段 结尾：总结：与其全部免费，不如保留低票价，同时给学生、老人、失业者免费或半价，再把省下的钱投入线路和班次。

口语 Part 2 和 Part 3：本周两个话题

每个话题先自己连续说 1 到 2 分钟，再看示范，挑一两个表达用到你自己的答案里。示范里的经历是编的，换成你自己的真实经历，更容易说得自然。

11/18 口语 Part 2：Describe a time when you had to wait for something（点开看参考范文）

You should say: what you were waiting for, where you were, how long you waited, and explain how you felt about it.

Part 2 参考范文（约 158 词，大概说 2 分钟）：

I'd like to talk about the time I waited for my visa interview result last year. I had applied for a short-term visa to visit my sister, and the embassy told me the decision would take up to two weeks.

I was at home most of the time, checking my email every ten minutes, which was honestly a bit silly. In the end I waited about eleven days, and during that time I couldn't really concentrate on anything.

At first I was excited, but after a week I got pretty anxious because I had already told my family and nearly booked the flights. Then, one morning, the email finally arrived and the visa was approved. I was so relieved that I actually jumped up and shouted.

Looking back, the waiting taught me to be more patient. These days, when I have to wait for something, I try to keep myself busy instead of just staring at my phone.

Part 3 参考回答：

Do you think people are less patient today than in the past?
Yes, I think so. We are used to instant things, like same-day delivery and fast messages, so even a short delay feels annoying. Our grandparents had to wait weeks for a letter, and they just accepted it.

Where do people usually have to wait in your country?
Mostly at hospitals, banks and government offices. Fortunately, a lot of places now let you book online, which saves loads of time.

How can companies make waiting less annoying for customers?
They can show the real waiting time and send text updates, and some give people a seat and a drink. If people know how long it will take, they feel much calmer.

11/20 口语 Part 2：Describe a useful skill you learned（点开看参考范文）

You should say: what the skill is, when and how you learned it, who taught you, and explain why it is useful.

Part 2 参考范文（约 160 词，大概说 2 分钟）：

I'd like to talk about cooking, which is a skill I picked up when I moved abroad for university. Before that, my mum did all the cooking, so I could hardly boil an egg.

I learned mainly from online videos and from my flatmate, who was a really good cook. He showed me the basics, like how to chop vegetables quickly and how to control the heat. I practised almost every evening for about three months.

It has turned out to be incredibly useful. First, I save a lot of money, because eating out every day is expensive. Second, it is much healthier, since I know exactly what goes into my food. And it is also a great way to relax after a long day.

On top of that, cooking has helped me make friends, because people love being invited for a home-made dinner. So I would say it is one of the most practical things I have ever learned.

Part 3 参考回答：

What skills are important for young people today?
I think communication and time management are the most important. Technical skills change quickly, but if you can talk to people and organise your time, you can learn almost anything else.

Is it better to learn a skill at school or by yourself?
Both work, but in different ways. School gives you structure and a teacher who corrects your mistakes, while learning alone is more flexible and you can follow your interests. Personally, I would combine them.

Do you think older people can learn new skills as easily as young people?
It may take a bit longer, but I don't think age is a real barrier. Older people are often more patient and motivated, and my grandfather learned to use a smartphone at seventy, so it is definitely possible.

6. 自查清单

  • 主词表遮住中文，至少能说出 99 个意思（大约 85%）。
  • 15 个听写词至少对 12 个，错的抄三遍。
  • 25 个听力表达能说出中文意思，并且至少能用 5 个各造一句。
  • 阅读易错题每道都能指出原文对应句，说清楚错在哪：同义替换没认出来、标题选成细节、NOT GIVEN 当成 FALSE，还是填空拼写和字数。
  • 讨论类大作文能说出四段式结构，每段第一句写什么，参考范文里的高亮句能默写一半。
  • 能说清楚非正式书信里感谢、讲经历、发邀请三段分别怎么写。
  • 两个口语 Part 2 话题各能连续说 1 分半钟以上，Part 3 每题能说 3 到 4 句。

写好的大作文、书信，或者口语录音转成的文字，直接发到聊天里，我帮你批改，告诉你大概几分、哪里可以改。
